Sports Guru

Scores the office competitions and hands you a block to paste into the standings sheet.
CLAUDE.AI PROJECT · OPEN FROM THE CHAT TAB

What it is

A shared Claude.ai Project that keeps score for School Tech's office competitions. Ask it for a week and it looks up what actually happened, applies our league rules, and gives you the points for every team — plus a one-click block you paste straight into the standings spreadsheet.

It currently covers the NFL Team Draft Game. Basketball and the January walking challenge can be added to the same project when they come around.

What it knows

  • The full scoring rules, including blowout, close-win and upset bonuses, playoff points and the end-of-season bonuses
  • Which rules were dropped for this season, so nobody re-litigates them mid-year
  • Every participant and the three teams they drafted
  • The exact column order and row layout of the WEEKLY DATA tab, so the paste lands in the right cells

How to use it

  1. Sign in at claude.ai with your @k12sta.com email and open Sports Guru in your Projects list.
  2. Ask for the week — for example, "score week 3."
  3. Skim the game table it gives you. Does that look like the week that happened?
  4. Copy the paste block, click the cell it names, and press Ctrl+V.

Everything downstream — weekly totals, season totals, the standings — recalculates on its own.

Check this every time: after you paste, make sure the last column (Chargers) got a number. If the row stops short of it, the paste came up short — undo and paste again. A short row silently puts points on the wrong people.

Where it helps most

The upset bonus. It starts in Week 11 and depends on each team's record entering that week, which is the part that is easy to get wrong by hand. Sports Guru shows the records it used next to every upset it awards, so a bad call is visible instead of buried in the total.

Try this: "Score week 12 — and show me the records you used for any upset wins."

What it will not do

  • It does not edit the spreadsheet. It produces the block; you paste it.
  • It does not guess a result. If it cannot find a game, it says which one and leaves those teams at zero until you confirm.
  • It does not score an unfinished week. It will tell you which games are still outstanding.
